Container.Name: Typr-Companion
Container.Overview: Typr Companion provides native latexmk/pdfLaTeX compilation and experimental TeXpresso live preview for Typr. It stores no projects and needs no persistent volume. For a browser on another device, publish this service through an HTTPS reverse proxy and enter that URL in Typr Settings > Editor > Typr Companion.
Container.Requires: Use only on a trusted LAN or VPN. Never expose this unauthenticated service to the public Internet. An HTTPS reverse proxy with WebSocket support is required when typr.ca runs in a browser on a different device.

Config.Name: Companion port
Config.Description: Host port used by the reverse proxy and local status checks. Container port must remain 8484.

Config.Name: Allowed Typr origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated exact browser origins allowed by CORS. Add a custom Typr deployment here if needed.
